dark-mode.warningMessage: design-token-system branch has 3 unmerged commits touching CSS custom properties also modified in this flag's changeset. Merge conflict risk is moderate.

new-onboarding-flow.warningMessage: profile-service-v2 and email-verification are referenced in onboarding route guards but neither flag is currently enabled in staging. Enabling this flag before its dependencies may cause a blank wizard screen for new users.

ai-suggestions.warningMessage: No open PRs conflict with this changeset. Minor note: the model inference client is imported in three files that also touch the legacy editor; verify bundle size impact before rollout.

profile-service-v2.warningMessage: Two open PRs modify UserProfile.avatarUrl in the same files as this flag's migration script. Rebase recommended before enabling in production.

billing-v3.warningMessage: payment-provider-stripe is disabled in the current environment. Billing v3 will fall through to the legacy gateway at runtime, which has been deprecated and may return 402 on new account types.

payment-provider-stripe.warningMessage: Stripe webhook handler added in commit a3f9c12 overlaps with the legacy payment event listener on /api/payments/webhook. Confirm only one handler will be active after the flag is toggled.

email-verification.warningMessage: Changeset is clean. Note that disabling this flag after users have already verified will leave orphaned verification tokens in the auth_tokens table — a cleanup migration may be needed.

design-token-system.warningMessage: Global CSS variable names were renamed in this branch (--color-bg → --surface-bg). 14 component files in main still reference the old names; dark-mode will render incorrectly until those files are updated.

export-to-csv.warningMessage: No conflicts detected. The CSV serialiser is tree-shaken from the production bundle when the flag is off, so no size regression on disable.

multi-region-failover.warningMessage: monitoring-dashboard and alerting-pipeline-v2 are both disabled in production. Enabling failover without active alerting means region switch events will be silent. Health-check thresholds in the config also appear stale (last updated 6 months ago).

monitoring-dashboard.warningMessage: Dashboard queries use a Prometheus scrape interval of 15 s, but the alerting-pipeline-v2 config expects 30 s. This mismatch causes duplicate alert firings in the staging environment.

alerting-pipeline-v2.warningMessage: Deduplication window defaults to 5 minutes. Existing on-call runbooks assume legacy alert IDs; the new pipeline generates UUIDs, so runbook links will break until updated.

onboarding.warningMessage: Alias for new-onboarding-flow. Same dependency warnings apply: profile-service-v2 and email-verification must be enabled first.

billing.warningMessage: Alias for billing-v3. payment-provider-stripe must be enabled before this flag is safe to turn on in production.

feature-flag.warningMessage: Meta-flag references detected in config loader. Toggling feature flags from within a feature-flagged code path can cause bootstrap ordering issues on cold start.
